# <Flow Name>

## Purpose

What this flow accomplishes and why it matters.

## Trigger

What starts the flow.

## Participants

Systems, services, users, jobs, routes, integrations, or external providers involved.

## Step-by-step flow

Main sequence of behavior. Include a diagram when the flow has branches, loops, or multiple participants.

## Data and state changes

Important data created, updated, deleted, cached, queued, or derived during the flow.

## Success behavior

What is true when the flow succeeds.

## Failure behavior

Important failure modes, retries, fallbacks, compensating behavior, and user-visible errors.

## External dependencies

External services, APIs, providers, infrastructure, or configuration required by this flow.

## Invariants and assumptions

Rules that must remain true for this flow to behave correctly.

## Security and privacy notes

Security-sensitive behavior, permissions, authentication, authorization, user data handling, and privacy assumptions. Omit only if clearly irrelevant.

## Observability and debugging

How to debug this flow: logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, admin screens, commands, or common symptoms.

## Testing notes

Important tests and how to validate changes.

## Source map

Relative Markdown links to the most important source files.

## Related docs

Links to related system docs, flow docs, ADRs, glossary entries, or external references.
